purpose: Provide an executable fixture-local YYZ inertial-Cartesian rigid-body formula and short open-loop trajectory core within the accepted scientific applicability domain.

provenance.notes: The Scientific Authority accepted the equations, assumptions and numerical policy for this fixture-local scope. The bundle does not select the canonical 00A or Legacy scenario and has no product or Legacy dependency.

expected_facts.claim: The independent Decimal reference and isolated C++17 probe agree on the declared translational, rotational and passive-Hamilton attitude derivatives and their semantic intermediates.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Semantic identities, units, frames and intermediate names are exact; each finite scalar uses the accepted fixture-local absolute-plus-relative formula tolerances.

expected_facts.claim: Classical RK4 reproduces the constant-translation analytic trajectory, converges at fourth order toward the principal-axis spin orientation, and converges in orientation and angular rate toward the high-precision non-principal torque-free trajectory while preserving rotational invariants.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Tick and ExactGrid time are exact; position, velocity and angular rate use separate fixture-local tolerances; orientation uses relative rotation angle; principal-axis and coupled errors decrease strictly with minimum observed order 3.8; torque-free energy and angular-momentum drift decrease across the step ladder and satisfy coarse and finest limits.

expected_facts.claim: An RK-stage domain failure discards the whole candidate, and invalid mass, inertia, quaternion, non-finite, dt and grid inputs are rejected without silent clamps.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Failure category, stage, evaluation time, candidate disposition, committed tick and rejection identities are exact; the last committed state uses field-specific fixture tolerances.

acceptance: The executable bundle records formula intermediates, analytic and high-precision trajectories, RK4 convergence, rotational invariants, ExactGrid termination and direct domain failures
The Python reference and C++17 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code

The Scientific Authority accepted the exact fixture-local model and normalization policy; the canonical YYZ mission, environment, subsystem models, terminal metric and production tolerances remain outside this slice
